tools.name: sanctions_check
tools.description: FREE. Screen one person, company or vessel name against Canada's consolidated autonomous sanctions list (SEMA / JVCFOA), incl. aliases. Best 3 matches.

tools.name: batch_screen
tools.description: PRO. Screen up to 200 names at once with an adjustable fuzzy threshold (50–100). Audit-ready output with list version.

tools.name: regime_list
tools.description: PRO. All listings for a country/regime (e.g. Russia, Iran, Belarus), optionally only those listed since a date.
